summary: Frontend-only testing of Ahorramix new features: welcome offer modal (BIENVENIDA10), demo Google login flow, account page, logos, mobile responsiveness. All 14 critical scenarios passed on both desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px).

issues: Cookie banner (cookie-accept) overlaps with the bottom of the welcome dialog on small screens. Not blocking, but modal + cookie bar together take up most of the viewport. Consider hiding cookie banner while welcome modal is open.

critical_code_review_comments: WelcomeOffer: localStorage.setItem('am_welcome_seen','1') is set when the setTimeout fires even if the user never sees it (e.g. navigates away during the 8s). Minor UX edge case.
Many 'non-static position' Lenis console warnings on every page load - noisy but non-functional.
AuthContext.goCheckout dependency array missing GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/AUTH_MODE check - fine as AUTH_MODE is a module constant.
test_credentials: N/A - demo mode local login only
context_for_next_testing_agent: All welcome-offer, login-dialog, account page, logo, and mobile-fit flows verified against the specified data-testids. The welcome modal uses localStorage key 'am_welcome_seen'; session key is 'am_session'. Delay is 8s (configurable in /public/ahorramix-config.js). Demo login button creates fixed user 'Cliente de prueba' / cliente.prueba@ejemplo.com. Cart coupon note at /carrito includes BIENVENIDA10. Logos naturalWidth=640 on both header and footer.
